notes: Sandbox Node was 22.23.5 and bootstrap requires Node 24, so Node 24.22.3 was installed from the npm 'node@24' package (~6 s) and used for every run.
Setup durations: bootstrap 281.7 s total (npm 10.5 s, submodule 8.4 s, reference build ~263 s on 4 vCPUs); baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+registry tests ~86 s.
Baseline before changes: typecheck, lint, boundaries and tests/unit/container-registry*.test.ts (3 files, 17 tests) passed; all still pass after.
No linux-gated cases: integer and byte-copy paths only.

Superseded by the audit note below (mov-claimed heads are now left undetected): Probe: native mov_probe outscores sdx_probe (50) when bytes 4..7 are an mp4 atom type such as 'free'; this divergence is tested and documented, not mirrored.

Audit (audit-fmt-b): undeclared SDX: heads whose byte-4 atom type mov_probe scores at 50 or more (13 tags) were detected as sdx while native fails; confirmSdx now leaves them undetected. Empty sample data was accepted while native's decoded framecrc prints #tb 0: 1/90000 (the decoder never opens); it is now refused before any output. The audit test ran on macOS arm64 against the pinned darwin reference (sha256 1b86106f…ab92), not on the sandbox linux-x64 build.
